rv.q: 4/5 Stars! The Irish writer-performer Mary Kate O Flanagan calls storytelling her religion, and her life-affirming solo performance Making a Show of Myself is sure to win her some acolytes.
Give yourself a gift and go see this woman who believes in magic.
...the production features a bare stage with black curtains and walls. O Flanagan emerges confidently and, for approximately 75 minutes, holds the audience’s rapt attention.

cn.t: Mary Kate O Flanagan's intimate storytelling show earns warm praise for its moving, life-affirming personal narratives. Critics laud the Grand Slam Champion's beguiling performance, though note it's unstructured theatre.
